cases.sentence: На ___ мы прибыли в Родос и оттуда отправились в Патару.
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

cases.sentence: А на ___ мы отправились в путь и пришли в Кесарию и остановились в доме проповедника Радостной Вести Филиппа, одного из семи помощников .
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed, and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

cases.sentence: На ___ Павел взял с собой этих людей и прошел вместе с ними обряд очищения.
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

cases.sentence: Уже перед ___ в казарму Павел сказал командиру римского полка:
cases.explain: «самым входом» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
